title: Fractal, Snowball’s design system
lede: A company design system that writes “brutal shadows” into its color documentation.
summary: Open-source fintech design system with black strokes, hard shadows, and pastel tones.

evidence.note: Downloaded and inspected `packages/fractal/public/images/cover_fractal.png` (3200 × 1800) from the repository. Licence read through the GitHub API. The Storybook site was not captured.

styles.note: The palette documentation names black as the color for “Strokes & Brutal shadows”, and swatch cards use black outlines and hard shadows.

context: The README describes “the open-source mono-repository for the design reference, components libraries and documentations of Fractal, Snowball’s design system”. Repository created 19 June 2023; MIT License, copyright 2023 Snowball. Documentation: [fractal.snowball.xyz](https://fractal.snowball.xyz/).
Listed under “Complete Design System” in the CC0 [Awesome Neobrutalism](https://github.com/ComradeAERGO/Awesome-Neobrutalism) list.
observed: Color swatch cards with black outlines and solid black shadows offset down and right.
Flat pastel and bright tones: mint, violet, yellow, cyan, and a primary pink #FF8ACD, with pure black #000000 as the secondary color.
The secondary color’s usage note lists “Strokes & Brutal shadows styles”.
Large heavy sans-serif headings on an off-white page.
interpretation: A production design system, not a demo kit. It shows the style formalized as tokens: one black for all strokes and shadows, and a tonal scale for each bright.
borrow: Reserve one color token for all outlines and hard shadows. Give each bright hue a few lighter tones for large backgrounds.
next: Capture the Storybook and snowball.xyz to measure outline width and shadow offset.

rights.statement: The repository is MIT-licensed, but the cover image includes the Snowball wordmark and a third-party emoji glyph, so it is not stored.
